ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the problem conditions: the solution set of the inequality ax-b<0 with respect to x is (1,+∞). The linear inequality ax-b<0 can be written as ax<b. If a>0, then the solution set should be x<b/a, which is a leftward interval and does not conform to (1,+∞); therefore it must be that a<0. Since a<0, when dividing both sides of ax<b by the negative number a, the inequality sign reverses, obtaining x>b/a. The given solution set is x>1, so b/a=1, namely b=a. Substitute b=a into the target inequality: (ax+b)(x-3)>0, obtaining (ax+a)(x-3)>0, namely a(x+1)(x-3)>0. Because a<0, after dividing by the negative number a, the inequality sign reverses, obtaining (x+1)(x-3)<0. The two zeros are -1 and 3; when the product of the quadratic factors is less than 0, x is between the two roots, so the solution set is (-1,3).

method.method_draft: 先从题面读取条件：不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)。对一次不等式按系数符号分析：若 a<0，则 ax-b<0 等价于 x>b/a，因此必须有 a<0 且 b/a=1，即 b=a。再把 b=a 代入目标不等式，得到 (ax+b)(x-3)=a(x+1)(x-3)>0。因为 a<0，两边除以负数时不等号反向，化为 (x+1)(x-3)<0。最后由二次因式符号法，两个零点为 -1 和 3，乘积小于 0 的区间是 (-1,3)。
method.CoT_raw: 从题面条件读出：关于 x 的不等式 ax-b<0 的解集为 (1,+∞)。一次不等式 ax-b<0 可写为 ax<b。若 a>0，则解集应为 x<b/a，是向左的区间，不符合 (1,+∞)；因此必须有 a<0。由于 a<0，ax<b 两边除以负数 a 时不等号反向，得到 x>b/a。题设解集为 x>1，所以 b/a=1，即 b=a。将 b=a 代入目标不等式：(ax+b)(x-3)>0，得到 (ax+a)(x-3)>0，即 a(x+1)(x-3)>0。因为 a<0，除以负数 a 后不等号反向，得到 (x+1)(x-3)<0。两个零点为 -1 和 3，二次因式乘积小于 0 时 x 在两根之间，所以解集为 (-1,3)。
